selection.aggregation_rationale: The selection contains one resolved campus and therefore cannot double count another campus row.
selection.confirming_evidence: Metered critical IT load, energized capacity records, and tenant reservations support the campus range and identify unused headroom.
selection.falsifying_evidence: The campus estimate is gross facility power, duplicates another site, or current load and reservations leave no compatible headroom.
selection.scope_description: A checked bridge demonstration for one campus tagged OpenAI confident in the pinned atlas release. It is not a claim that all campus power is vacant or assigned to NVIDIA platforms.

commissioning_completion_ratio.confirming_evidence: Dated rack-level handoff records show that roughly this share of scheduled slots reaches operational acceptance within the quarter.
commissioning_completion_ratio.falsifying_evidence: Acceptance logs show materially different completion rates or that delayed racks roll into another quarter.
commissioning_completion_ratio.methodology: Synthetic target-quarter completion ratio used only to exercise the commissioning branch.

commissioning_slots.confirming_evidence: A site commissioning schedule identifies this many distinct NVL72 rack acceptance slots in the target quarter.
commissioning_slots.falsifying_evidence: Rack delivery, coolant-loop, electrical, network, burn-in, or acceptance records support materially different throughput.
commissioning_slots.methodology: Synthetic count of rack commissioning slots available during 2026-Q3; it is not a site forecast.

contracted_reservations.confirming_evidence: Executed capacity reservations identify committed MW that is not already present in metered current load.
contracted_reservations.falsifying_evidence: Reservation ledgers show a materially different total or show that these MW are already counted in current load.
contracted_reservations.methodology: Synthetic incremental reservation range, excluding capacity already counted in current critical IT load.

current_critical_it_load.confirming_evidence: Metered site critical IT load over the target-quarter planning window supports this range.
current_critical_it_load.falsifying_evidence: Revenue-grade meters or operator load reports show materially different energized IT load.
current_critical_it_load.methodology: Synthetic current-load range used to demonstrate subtraction from the imported gross critical-IT envelope.

deductions.non_overlap_rationale: Current load covers energized consumption only. Reservations cover contracted but not yet energized capacity. Other-platform commitments exclude both current load and reservations. Rack-incompatible capacity is the remaining otherwise-uncommitted MW that fails NVL72 density or liquid-cooling requirements. This partition is a scenario contract, not an observed fact.

other_platform_commitments.confirming_evidence: Platform allocation schedules identify committed MW not present in current load or the reservation ledger.
other_platform_commitments.falsifying_evidence: Allocation schedules show a materially different total or overlap with current load or contracted reservations.
other_platform_commitments.methodology: Synthetic MW committed to non-target compute platforms after excluding load and reservations.

rack_incompatible_capacity.confirming_evidence: Electrical one-lines, cooling-loop capacity, and hall density maps identify residual MW that cannot host NVL72 racks.
rack_incompatible_capacity.falsifying_evidence: Engineering records show materially different liquid-cooling or rack-density-compatible residual capacity.
rack_incompatible_capacity.methodology: Synthetic residual MW that is neither loaded nor committed but lacks target-rack power-density or liquid-cooling compatibility.

estimate.confirming_evidence: Metered critical IT load, energized capacity records, and tenant reservations support the campus range and identify unused headroom.
estimate.falsifying_evidence: The campus estimate is gross facility power, duplicates another site, or current load and reservations leave no compatible headroom.
estimate.methodology: Summed critical_it_mw across 1 explicitly selected Data Center Atlas site(s) for OpenAI Stargate Abilene site envelope. This is a gross site critical IT power envelope, not vacant or platform-allocated MW. Existing load, reservations, and rack-compatible headroom must be removed before use as an incremental power pool. Aggregation: single_site. Rationale: The selection contains one resolved campus and therefore cannot double count another campus row.

rack_it_load.confirming_evidence: A current NVIDIA rack guide or measured critical-IT telemetry supports approximately 120 kW at full rack load.
rack_it_load.falsifying_evidence: A platform-specific NVIDIA revision or metered rack data establishes a materially different full-load critical-IT requirement.
rack_it_load.methodology: Convert NVIDIA's approximate 120 kW full-rack load to 0.12 MW per NVL72 rack. This is critical-IT rack power, not total facility power with PUE.

target_platform_share.confirming_evidence: A dated customer and platform allocation schedule assigns this share of residual compatible MW to the target rack platform.
target_platform_share.falsifying_evidence: Customer or platform allocation schedules assign a materially different share or no capacity to the target platform.
target_platform_share.methodology: Synthetic share of residual compatible MW allocated to the target NVL72 rack platform.

methodology.gross_to_net: For each draw, subtract current critical-IT load, contracted reservations, other-platform commitments, and rack-incompatible capacity from gross critical-IT MW, flooring residual power at zero.
methodology.operational_throughput: Divide target MW by rack critical-IT MW, then take the minimum of power-supported racks and target-quarter commissioning slots times their completion ratio.
methodology.platform_allocation: Apply the target-platform share only to residual compatible MW.
methodology.shadow_capacity: Shadow power is target-allocated compatible MW left unused when commissioning binds; shadow commissioning capacity is completed rack throughput left unused when power binds.

scenario.name: Abilene gross-to-net operational rack demonstrator
scenario.notes: The imported gross envelope is live and hash-pinned. Every site-specific deduction, target allocation, and commissioning value is synthetic.
scenario.scope_description: A checked method demonstration for one Data Center Atlas campus. It does not estimate actual OpenAI, Oracle, NVIDIA, or site-operator capacity or deployments.

capacity.notes: Epoch AI modeled current capacity; 80% interval is base divided/multiplied by 1.4.

warnings: The imported MW range is a gross site critical-IT envelope, not vacant or platform-allocated capacity.
Deductions are additive only because the scenario supplies an explicit non-overlap rationale; overlapping categories would double count unavailable power.
Operational racks are the lower of power-supported racks and completed commissioning slots in the target quarter.
Site load, reservations, platform commitments, compatibility, allocation, and commissioning inputs are synthetic; outputs are not an estimate of actual Abilene headroom or deployments.
